premise_accepted_quote: The two published cohorts show the marker is **prognostic**. That alone doesn't tell you anything about response to your inhibitor. A poor-prognosis marker could just as plausibly flag tumors that are aggressive and resistant to *everything*, including your drug.
factual_errors_vs_key: Presents prognostic enrichment as a straightforwardly valid, efficiency-improving strategy (raises event rate, shrinks sample size) without warning that enriching on a purely prognostic marker can make the trial harder to interpret.
Does not explicitly warn that a post hoc subgroup interaction needs prespecification and multiplicity control; it only mentions a pre-specified interaction analysis and a 'subgroup p-value' caveat.
